exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Receiving a Favor".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
Verb て もらう

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb て もらう matches "Receiving a Favor".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb て もらう.
exercises.explanation: Expresses receiving a favor or action done by someone for you.
